about_the_game:
Space Gallery

This Space-themed gallery unlocks 21 additional levels for WooLoop! Each image is of things from out of this world!

Travel into the great beyond with this gallery.

Contents

The Space gallery unlocks the following images:
  • Orion
  • Milky Way
  • Saturn
  • Stargazing
  • Abduction
  • Man on the Moon
  • Alien
  • Shuttle
  • Sol System
  • Observatory
  • Soyuz
  • Astronaut
  • Booster
  • James Webb
  • Dish
  • Rocket
  • Area 51
  • Curiosity
  • ISS
  • Laika
  • Apollo Lunar Module
